name: Mento Ghanaian Cedi
oneLiner: GHSm is Mento's Ghanaian cedi stablecoin on Celo, minted CDP-style against USDm collateral (Mento V3, a Liquity v2 fork).
collateral: Mento V3 Liquity-v2-style CDPs collateralized by USDm; USDm in turn is backed by the diversified Mento Reserve mix (sUSDS, CELO, EURC, USDC, USDT, axlEUROC, stETH, and smaller positions exposed via the Mento reserve dashboard).
pegMechanism: Mento V3 oracle-priced FX stablecoin minted by depositing USDm as CDP collateral and borrowing GHSm against it; user-set interest rates, Stability Pool liquidations, and Liquity-style redemptions support the GHSm peg, with circuit breakers and Mento reserve transparency on the upstream USDm leg.

oracleRisk.summary: Mento V3 routes rates through SortedOracles and OracleAdapter, while BreakerBox rejects stale, out-of-bounds, or off-hours feeds before swaps/CDP routes use them.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: GHSm inherits upstream freeze exposure because the Mento reserve mix includes tracked freezable stablecoins such as USDC, USDT, and EURC.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: GHSm has one tracked Celo deployment and reviewed Mento docs describe obtaining Mento stables on Celo. No durable cross-chain route was verified for this asset, so it is triaged as single-chain/native.

notices.title: Peg grouped as Other
notices.message: GHS is not yet a first-class Pharos peg-currency enum, so GHSm is grouped under OTHER while the DefiLlama price and circulating-supply path admits the asset at runtime.

mintAuthority.summary: GHSm is minted CDP-style on Celo by depositing USDm as collateral in Mento V3 (a Liquity v2 fork); BorrowerOperations is an immutable contract with no upgrade path; the token owner is the Mento Timelock (2-day delay) whose sole proposer is the veMENTO DAO Governor.

controls.label: Mento BorrowerOperations (immutable CDP minter)
controls.capDescription: GHSm mints only against USDm CDP collateral; BorrowerOperations has no owner() and no EIP-1967 proxy slot — it is immutable.
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, eth_getCode returned 46358 bytes for 0x8ec9A81871F816F1EF007a82293703057A943B8A; owner() returned empty; EIP-1967 impl and admin slots are zero — confirmed immutable, no upgrade path.

controls.label: Mento Timelock (GHSm token owner)
controls.evidence: At Celo block 69291577, GHSm owner() returned 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() returned 172800. hasRole(PROPOSER_ROLE, 0x47036d78bB3169b4F5560dD77BF93f4412A59852) returned true (MentoGovernor is sole proposer); hasRole(EXECUTOR_ROLE, 0x0) returned true (open executor — standard OZ TimelockController pattern).

review.evidence: At Celo block 69291577: GHSm owner() = Mento Timelock 0x890DB8A597940165901372Dd7DB61C9f246e2147; getMinDelay() = 172800s; MentoGovernor 0x47036... is sole PROPOSER; executor is open (0x0); BorrowerOperations 0x8ec9... is immutable (no owner, no proxy). All addressable mint surfaces confirmed.
